items.text: Philadelphia QB: Joe Milton III makes his first start (as the schedule lists); Tanner McKee (rib) questionable/backup. Jalen Hurts out.

Philadelphia FINAL: RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) cleared to play. OUT - WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), WR Britain Covey (knee), LB Jihaad Campbell (hamstring/quad), CB Jonathan Jones (hamstring), DB Michael Carter II (abdomen).
New York Giants FINAL: RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring) doubtful; WR Charlie Jones (hand) questionable. No other designations (OLB Abdul Carter, OT Andrew Thomas cleared). J.J. McCarthy starts.
